prerequisites.capability: basic familiarity with organizational hiring context
prerequisites.rationale: The department hiring scenario is the sole instructional stimulus for lo-hrp-01, lo-hrp-02, asmt-hrp-f-01, and asmt-hrp-s-01. A learner with no awareness of what organizational hiring involves cannot interpret that stimulus; engagement with the scenario prompt would fail before any recruitment-planning instruction could begin. This capability is not addressed by any supplied objective and is not developed by the instruction.

prerequisites.capability: written communication at a functional level
prerequisites.rationale: lo-hrp-02 unconditionally requires producing a written recruitment plan (asmt-hrp-s-01, ev-hrp-s01-01 through ev-hrp-s01-03). A learner unable to produce legible structured prose cannot satisfy any of the three summative evidence criteria for that assessment. lo-hrp-03 also permits a written justification path (asmt-hrp-s-02). The oral option in asmt-hrp-s-02 does not remove this requirement because the plan-production task in asmt-hrp-s-01 is unconditionally written. This surface constraint is not taught by any supplied objective.

lo-hrp-03 and asmt-hrp-s-02 require the learner to supply at least one rationale per sequencing decision that explicitly references dependencies between steps (ev-hrp-s02-01). This requires the prior ability to reason that one step must logically or operationally precede another. No supplied objective is scoped to developing this general reasoning skill; lo-hrp-03 applies it within a recruitment-planning domain context but does not build it from zero. Without it, the learner cannot produce any dependency-referenced justification, causing ev-hrp-s02-01 to fail entirely.

modules.title: Creating a Recruitment Plan from a Hiring Scenario

planning_warnings.rationale: The 60-minute budget must cover instruction and embedded assessment across three cognitive levels (understand, create, evaluate). Module time allocations of 15/30/15 minutes are candidate only. Optional elaboration, worked examples, and iterative practice cycles have been excluded to fit within the budget. Time allocation between asmt-hrp-s-01 and asmt-hrp-s-02 within mod-hrp-02 and mod-hrp-03 respectively is not separately resolved here; researcher must verify feasibility of the summative assessment sequence within the remaining time after instruction.

sequencing_rationale: mod-hrp-01 is positioned first because lo-hrp-02 explicitly lists lo-hrp-01 as a prerequisite; learners must identify and classify recruitment plan components before they can create a plan.

mod-hrp-02 follows mod-hrp-01 because plan creation (lo-hrp-02) depends on component knowledge established in lo-hrp-01 and because the plan produced under asmt-hrp-s-01 is the required input artifact for mod-hrp-03.

mod-hrp-03 is positioned last because lo-hrp-03 lists both lo-hrp-01 and lo-hrp-02 as prerequisites and because asmt-hrp-s-02 explicitly requires the plan from asmt-hrp-s-01or an equivalent authored plan as its stimulus.

Formative assessment asmt-hrp-f-01 is scoped to mod-hrp-01 as a readiness check before the plan-creation task; summative assessments asmt-hrp-s-01 and asmt-hrp-s-02 are scoped to mod-hrp-02 and mod-hrp-03 respectively as terminal performance measures.

assumption_notes: Module time allocations (15/30/15 minutes) are candidate only; the 60-minute total must cover both instruction and assessment and has not been verified against actual task completion time data.
The three candidate prerequisites (pre-hrp-01, pre-hrp-02, pre-hrp-03) are referenced at course and module level but remain unconfirmed pending researcher validation.
lesson_ids are left empty throughout; lesson derivation is delegated to downstream orchestration after lesson generation.

Assessment sequencing within modules reflects the dependency stated in asmt-hrp-s-02 (depends on asmt-hrp-s-01 output); the exact intra-module time split is candidate only and requires researcher decision.

review_instructions.overview: Review the complete instructional-design proposal once before scoring. Evaluate machine validity separately from pedagogical quality.
review_instructions.scoring_scale: Use 1-5 for every dimension: 1 poor, 3 mixed/acceptable, 5 strong.
review_instructions.mandatory_question: Ignoring machine traceability or schema issues, is this instructional design pedagogically reasonable? Answer YES, PARTIALLY, or NO with a short rationale.
blinding_rules: Do not infer how the proposal was generated.
Do not assume a machine observation means the design is pedagogically poor.
Do not repair the design while scoring; record edit effort separately.
